subject: bryn-eriksson
label: Planning Mode
from: Bryn answers Torie's bratting, always, eventually
to: EXCEPT IN PLANNING MODE, where the answer simply does not come
note:
THE ONE DOCUMENTED STATE IN WHICH VICTORIA ERIKSSON CANNOT GET WHAT SHE WANTS.

Torie brats for CONSEQUENCES, and the system is reliable to the point of being a household constant — she provokes, Bryn answers, everyone gets what they came for. On 7 September she escalated to lying face-down across the September grid of the big calendar, in Bryn's way, with her own ten inches trapped underneath her, and Bryn WROTE AROUND HER RIBCAGE for twenty minutes without comment.

PLANNING MODE IS NOT COLDNESS AND IT IS NOT PUNISHMENT. It is the same attention that built this house: when Bryn is provisioning for the family she goes entirely into the task, and a brat lying on the seventeenth registers as an OBSTACLE TO WRITE AROUND rather than an invitation. Torie knows this. Torie does it anyway, which is either optimism or a different game.

THE MODE ENDS WHEN THE LIST DOES. Everything Torie has accrued in the meantime is still owed and Bryn has never once forgotten a single item of it.
